telegram.title: Telegram Notifications
telegram.howDesc: Click "Bind Telegram" to generate a one-time link, send /start to the bot in the opened Telegram, and the binding completes automatically.
telegram.pendingDesc: Send /start to @{{bot}} in Telegram; this page confirms automatically once done.
telegram.unbindConfirm: You will stop receiving push messages. Unbind?
telegram.disabledDesc: The administrator has not enabled Telegram binding. Please contact the administrator.
telegram.testOk: Test message sent; check your Telegram
telegram.testFailNotConfigured: Send failed: push not configured (missing bot token); contact your administrator
telegram.testFailNetwork: Send failed: network unreachable (server must reach api.telegram.org; check proxy settings)
telegram.testFailToken: Send failed: bot token is invalid or cannot message this chat; ask your administrator to update it
telegram.testFailUnknown: Send failed (unknown reason); ask your administrator to check backend logs
telegram.hint: How to get it: message @userinfobot on Telegram; it replies with your numeric chat_id.

wxpusher.title: WeChat Notifications
wxpusher.howDesc: Click "Scan QR to bind WeChat" to generate a one-time QR code; scan it with WeChat and confirm as prompted; the binding completes automatically.
wxpusher.pendingDesc: Scan the QR code below with WeChat and confirm as prompted; this card updates automatically once bound.
wxpusher.testOk: Test message sent; check your WeChat notifications
wxpusher.unbindConfirm: You will stop receiving WeChat push messages. Unbind?
wxpusher.revokedDesc: This WeChat binding was unbound; scan again to rebind.
wxpusher.loadFailed: Failed to load the QR code, please retry
